Our Structure

Organisational Chart

The governance and operational structure of St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital under the Goaso Diocesan Health Service.

⛪
Bishop of Goaso Diocese
Supreme spiritual and administrative authority over all diocesan health institutions.
🏛️
Health Service Board
Governance board that sets policy and strategic direction for diocesan health services.
🩺
Medical Director
Leads all clinical operations, specialist services, and public health programmes.
📋
Administrator
Manages HR, finance, logistics, transport, facilities, and all support departments.
👩‍⚕️
Nurse Manager
Oversees nursing staff, midwives, nurse specialists, and ward assistants.
✝️
Chaplain
Provides pastoral care and spiritual support to patients, staff, and their families.

Goaso Diocesan Health Service

St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital operates under the governance of the Goaso Diocesan Health Service Board, in alignment with the Catholic Diocese of Goaso and the Christian Health Association of Ghana (CHAG).
